---
title: "Data downloads and caching"
---

Instantiating an atlas downloads several gigabytes. Nothing in the API signals this, so it is
worth knowing before you put `AllenAtlas()` inside a loop, a test, or a CI job.

```python
ba = AllenAtlas()   # first call: large download. Later calls: read from cache.
```

The download happens once per resolution and is cached on disk. Subsequent calls are cheap.

## Where the data goes

The cache directory is derived from ONE's `CACHE_DIR` parameter by
`BrainAtlas._get_cache_dir`, which appends a fixed subpath:

```
<ONE CACHE_DIR>/histology/ATLAS/Needles/Allen
```

Note that `Needles` appears in the path regardless of which atlas you instantiate — it is part
of the historical layout, not a statement about the scaling in use. See
[Choosing an atlas](choosing-an-atlas.qmd).

## Two remote sources

- **The Allen Institute**, over HTTP, for the atlas volumes themselves
  (`_download_atlas_allen`). The data is the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (2015) with the 2017
  region annotations.
- **The `ibl-brain-wide-map-public` S3 bucket**, declared as `S3_BUCKET_IBL`, for the
  IBL-repackaged resources — the flat maps, the genomics volumes, the connectivity tables and
  the streamlines described in
  [External data in the common space](external-data-in-the-common-space.qmd).

## ONE is required, even without IBL data

`_get_cache_dir` reads ONE's parameters, so **ONE must be installed and configured** before an
atlas can be instantiated — including for users who never touch IBL experimental data and only
want the anatomy.

If `AllenAtlas()` fails on a fresh machine, an unconfigured ONE is the first thing to check:
the cache path cannot be resolved without it.

## Practical consequences

- **Do not instantiate an atlas in a tight loop.** Build one and pass it in. Most functions
  that need one accept a `brain_atlas` or `br` argument for exactly this reason.
- **Resolution costs space.** The 10 µm volume is substantially larger than the 25 µm default;
  take the default unless you need the detail.
- **CI needs the cache warmed or the calls avoided.** This documentation site renders from a
  committed freeze precisely so that building it downloads nothing.
